correctness.rationale: Fresh-marker border restriction and induction over highest bit of the two flank lengths prove the full iff condition for all ranks, with both-high-one exhibiting an explicit border. All boundary cases m=0 and empty flanks are included. Independent brute checking ranks 1..8 and entire bit matrices m=0..7 passed; finite tests are not confused with the proof.

value.rationale: Unbordered-factor spectra are a motivated formal-language invariant studied in arxiv:1211.1301. The result provides an exact infinite family and complete rank-and-length classification for classical Zimin words. The carry-free binary-support condition and exact lacunary digit-sum spectrum are structural rather than a renamed or single-parameter exercise; no different downstream application is required for this intrinsic combinatorial classification. The result is restricted to finite literal Zimin words.
